decisions.title: How the data API is built

revisions.choice: Plain Django JSON views under /api/v1 in a new apps/api package that call the existing service functions; no new framework.
revisions.rationale: Every write already goes through service functions with expected revisions; a thin JSON layer reuses them and adds no dependency.

revisions.choice: Plain Django JSON views under /api/v1 in a new apps/api package that call the existing service functions; no new framework.
revisions.rationale: Unchanged choice; the decision now belongs to the backend developer. The frontend builds against it as a working assumption (design engineer, 13 Nov 2026).

decisions.title: Sign-in and session for the frontend

revisions.choice: Same-origin deployment: the Next.js app and /api/v1 are served behind one host; the Django session cookie authenticates; writes send the CSRF token header.
revisions.rationale: C-05 says people sign in once and Django keeps login; same origin avoids CORS and token storage in the browser.
alternatives: Separate origins with CORS and credentials

revisions.choice: Same-origin deployment: the Next.js app and /api/v1 are served behind one host; the Django session cookie authenticates; writes send the CSRF token header.
revisions.rationale: Unchanged choice; the decision now belongs to the backend developer. The frontend builds against it as a working assumption (design engineer, 13 Nov 2026).
alternatives: Separate origins with CORS and credentials

decisions.title: Where the frontend and API run

revisions.choice: Not chosen. Needed before the first release, not before local development.
revisions.rationale: No deployment is authorised in this phase.
alternatives: Node server behind the same reverse proxy as Django

revisions.choice: Polling: lists every 15 seconds while visible, an open work item every 5 seconds while an agent is working; no push channel in v1.
revisions.rationale: Simple and works with session auth and the existing request model; push can follow if volume demands it.

revisions.choice: Polling: lists every 15 seconds while visible, an open work item every 5 seconds while an agent is working; no push channel in v1.
revisions.rationale: Accepted as proposed by the design engineer, 13 Nov 2026 (frontend behaviour).

revisions.choice: Cursor paging, 50 rows per page, newest activity first; counts per queue returned separately.
revisions.rationale: C-06 high volume; matches the "Show more" pattern in the design.

revisions.choice: Cursor paging with a rows-per-page choice of 10, 20 or 50 on every list (default 20); newest activity first; counts per queue returned separately.
revisions.rationale: Design engineer, 13 Nov 2026: users choose 10, 20 or 50 rows per page. Default 20 is a proposal within that choice.

revisions.choice: Add Notification (per person, per work item event) and AlertPreference (channel WhatsApp/email/both, frequency) records; sends go through the existing outbox to a mock adapter until I-03 is connected.
revisions.rationale: No notification or preference model exists; the outbox pattern already handles uncertain sends.

revisions.choice: Add Notification (per person, per work item event) and AlertPreference (channel WhatsApp/email/both, frequency) records; sends go through the existing outbox to a mock adapter until I-03 is connected.
revisions.rationale: Unchanged choice; the decision now belongs to the backend developer. The frontend builds against it as a working assumption (design engineer, 13 Nov 2026).

records.title: Document and version
constraints: Decisions bind to a version

records.title: Invoice, receipt and allocation
constraints: Stages, invoices, receipts and allocations are separate
Unknown amounts are not zero

records.title: Versioned configuration (rules)
constraints: A missing value is Not set, never a default

records.title: Notification (new)
constraints: One per person per event
Carries no amounts or client details

records.title: Alert preference (new)
constraints: One per person

records.title: Assistant conversation and message (new)
constraints: Every assistant message lists its sources
Drafts link to a started work item, never a finished one

invariants.title: Every record and action is checked by the backend
invariants.rule: Each endpoint resolves the case and calls require(actor, case, action) or the line's authority check before reading or writing; lists filter by grants.

invariants.title: Act only on the current version
invariants.rule: Writes carry expected_revision; a mismatch returns 409 and changes nothing.

invariants.title: Facts are never merged
invariants.rule: Payloads return drafted, reviewed, approved, sent, receipt recorded and verified as separate facts; paid is separate Finance data.

invariants.title: Unknown is not zero
invariants.rule: Amounts and dates that are not known are returned with unknown=true and no value.
invariants.scope: All payloads with amounts or dates

invariants.title: Agents never decide
invariants.rule: Agent runs can draft, read and explain; decision, send and pay endpoints reject agent actors.

invariants.title: Check before resending
invariants.rule: A send with an unknown outcome blocks any new send until reconciled.

invariants.title: History is append-only
invariants.rule: Every write adds an audit event; nothing edits or deletes one.

invariants.title: Payroll rows stay with HR
invariants.rule: Individual payroll rows are returned only to roles with payroll private read; others get totals.

invariants.title: Sample data is labelled
invariants.rule: Records from synthetic or demo cases carry sample=true in every payload.

integrations.title: WhatsApp and email alerts
integrations.purpose: Tell people what is waiting for them (I-03).
integrations.data: Agent name, one line, work reference, app link; no amounts or client details.
integrations.secret_boundary: Provider credentials server-only; never in the frontend.
integrations.failure_recovery: Outbox retries up to 3 times; an unknown send outcome is reconciled before any resend.

operations.name: queue_alert
operations.contract: From T-ALERTS on, decision and state changes (E-TASK-DECIDE, E-WORK-ACTION) write Notification rows and an outbox entry; E-NOTIFICATIONS lists them; JOB-ALERTS sends per preference.
operations.authentication: Internal; no external call at queue time.

integrations.title: Agent language model provider
integrations.data: Only records the requesting person may read; payroll private rows never leave HR scope.
integrations.failure_recovery: Agent run marked stopped with a reason; the person sees "cannot answer"; no record changes.

operations.name: run_assistant
operations.contract: E-MESSAGE stores the message and queues JOB-ASSISTANT; the worker calls the provider and stores the answer with sources.
operations.authentication: Internal queue; provider call authenticated server-side when chosen.

jobs.title: Send alerts
jobs.recovery: After the limit, park and show the send as uncertain; reconcile before any resend.

jobs.title: Answer an assistant message
jobs.recovery: Mark the run stopped with a reason; the conversation shows cannot answer; the person may ask again.

scenarios.title: Floor counts from visible records
scenarios.given: A PMO Lead with sample work
scenarios.then: Counts match visible work; reduced motion shows the flat view

scenarios.title: Month-end and import
scenarios.given: October with one missing bank statement
scenarios.when: Read month-end; submit a file with a wrong period row
scenarios.then: Cash received shows known amount plus Unknown; import is quarantined with findings

scenarios.title: Payroll rows stay with HR
scenarios.then: HR Lead gets rows; Finance Lead gets 403

scenarios.title: Rules are versioned and Not set is explicit
scenarios.then: Read shows set=false; save creates a new revision; stale revision 409

scenarios.title: Preferences and notification centre
scenarios.when: Change to daily email; trigger a decision
scenarios.then: Preference saved; notification listed; mock adapter records the send

scenarios.title: Assistant answers with sources and drafts
scenarios.given: A Finance user and a restricted payroll record
scenarios.when: Ask about a project; ask for payroll figures; ask for an invoice draft
scenarios.then: Answer cites records; payroll: cannot answer, says why; draft links to a started line, not approved

scenarios.title: Report figures link to records
scenarios.given: Monthly report with an unknown figure
scenarios.then: Each figure lists its sources; unknown is unknown

scenarios.title: Frontend meets devices and WCAG 2.2 AA
scenarios.when: Run automated accessibility checks and test on phone and desktop
scenarios.then: No AA violations; focus ring and reduced motion work; layouts at 390px and 1440px

runbooks.title: People report "this version changed" repeatedly
steps: Read the work item history for revisions
Check whether an agent keeps redrafting
runbooks.recovery: Stop the redrafting cause; the person reloads and decides the current version.

runbooks.title: A send outcome is unknown
steps: Check the provider or recipient for receipt
Record delivered, not delivered or still unknown with evidence
Resend only after not delivered is recorded
